title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Decision dossier for a binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. It includes a fully specified Activity across projects reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, and a Navigation citizenship chapter with light/dark Dossiers tree variants, waiting-decision signal semantics, state behavior, and a bounded follow-up slice.
